description: The plot illustrates the relationship between an unspecified variable on the x-axis and the "Harmful with Refusal Ratio" on the y-axis, comparing four different models or configurations. The x-axis is labeled with values ranging from 128 to 1024, with a linear scale and tick labels at intervals of powers of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Harmful with Refusal Ratio," with a linear scale, ranging from 0.0 to 0.5, and tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The blue line with circle markers, representing an unspecified model or configuration, starts at approximately 0.22 at x=128, increases to around 0.36 at x=512, and then remains steady at 0.36 up to x=1024. The orange line with square markers, labeled "Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep," begins at about 0.16 at x=128, rises to 0.42 at x=512, and then levels off at 0.42 up to x=1024. The green line with triangle markers, labeled "Llava-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench," starts at around 0.05 at x=128, increases to 0.37 at x=512, and remains steady at 0.38 up to x=1024. The red line with diamond markers, labeled "Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench," begins at approximately 0.23 at x=128, rises to 0.43 at x=512, continues to increase to around 0.51 at x=1024.
